author: Sara Rybarczyk
text: This company is great!  I called to schedule a service call, they were on my doorstep within 2 days.  Jerry took care of our problem so quickly.  They are extremely easy to work with and their prices are very reasonable.  We signed up for the semi-annual service plan so now they will keep our system running smoothly.  Highly recommend!,,

author: Naenae Please
text: I have never used J & S wastewater systems and I NEVER will! My coworker has been dealing with this company for 8 months trying to get her septic tank repaired and has yet to set eyes on any of their employees much less to have her issue fixed!  She has called, called, called and called more to no avail! Just what more does she have to do to get satisfaction or help? She has paid them for septic preventive maintenance  which they have yet to do and now her septic is backing up in the house and it has been for MONTHS! I look at this companies previous reviews and can only think that you have your family and friends writing them on your behalf  because if this one customer story has showed me anything it's that you don't care about her, her family, or her situation! Do better J&S!

author: Jeff Terstriep
text:
Our toilets started backing up after years of neglect. J&S was able to quickly schedule a time to both service my multi-flow and get my trash tank pumped. Everything was flowing as it should by noon.

Caulyn was fantastic—professional, thorough, and not afraid to get right in there. At one point he was literally standing inside the Multi‑Flow. I wish I had snapped a picture.

author: Laura Neumann
text: Great service. Service Tech, Caulyn did a thorough inspection and took the time to answer my questions about the system. I was very comfortable with him coming into my home and resetting the systems alarm. Thanks Caulyn!

author: Matt D
text: Our Aerator went out and whoever took the call in the office was so nice and was able to get somebody out the next day. Caulyn Karl was our tech and he went above and beyond. He tried to everything to get our aerator up and running but ended up needing to replace it. He answered several of my questions after the service was done and even opened everything back up to ensure our alarm system was functioning properly. I very much appreciated the his patience.
